title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - LEE) relative to grant funding from Round 2 of the Governor’s Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation's Extreme Heat and Community…
text:
[Council File 24-0213-S1; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - LEE) relative to grant funding from Round 2 of the Governor’s Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation's Extreme Heat and Community Resilience Program for the Broadway-Manchester Active Transportation Project (Broadway Sur) Heat Resilient Green Corridor.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services, with the assistance of any necessary agencies, to prepare and submit all necessary application forms and documentation to seek grant funding from Round 2 of the Governor’s Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation's Extreme Heat and Community Resilience Program for the Broadway Sur Heat Resilient Corridor.
2. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services to partner with a 501(c)(3) non-profit entity (or multiple entities) as the co-applicant(s) on the preparation of application forms and documentation for Round 2 of the Extreme Heat and Community Resilience Program and negotiate any necessary agreements to formalize such partnerships.
3. INSTRUCT the Bureau of Street Services to return to Council prior to receiving authority to accept/execute any necessary grant agreements.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council would authorize the Bureau of Street Services to apply for state Extreme Heat and Community Resilience grant funding for the Broadway Sur green corridor, with a nonprofit co-applicant, and to return before accepting any grant.
